rows.caveat: Not a C-MAPSS FD002 study

rows.model: Clusters diverse operating conditions with K-means and normalizes by cluster

rows.paper: Condition-Aware AI for Predictive Maintenance: Dual-Attention CNN-GRU with Per-Regime Scaling
rows.model: Uses unsupervised operating-regime clustering and per-regime scaling
rows.caveat: RUL rather than anomaly detection

rows.paper: Domain Adaptation via Alignment of Operation Profile for Remaining Useful Lifetime Prediction
rows.model: Aligns operating profiles for cross-condition generalization
rows.caveat: Different dataset and RUL endpoint

rows.paper: A Self-Organizing Map and a Normalizing Multi-Layer Perceptron Approach to Baselining in Prognostics under Dynamic Regimes

rows.model: Learns operating-condition baselines before degradation assessment
rows.caveat: Prognostics-oriented

rows.paper: A Comparison of Residual-based Methods on Fault Detection
rows.model: Compares autoencoder residuals with input-output models that condition on operating variables
rows.caveat: Not the FD002 study

rows.paper: Isolation Forest
rows.model: Isolation-based anomaly scoring with subsampling
rows.caveat: Window flattening discards temporal order

rows.paper: LOF: Identifying Density-Based Local Outliers
rows.model: Local-density deviation score

rows.paper: Estimating the Support of a High-Dimensional Distribution
rows.model: One-class SVM learns the support of normal data
rows.caveat: Sensitive to scaling and hyperparameters

rows.paper: Detecting Spacecraft Anomalies Using LSTMs and Nonparametric Dynamic Thresholding
rows.model: Couples temporal model errors with a dynamic nonparametric threshold
rows.caveat: Different telemetry benchmark and supervised incident context

rows.paper: Anomaly Detection in Streams with Extreme Value Theory
rows.model: SPOT controls tail risk without a fixed distributional threshold
rows.caveat: Originally univariate; multivariate score must be aggregated first

rows.paper: Robust Anomaly Detection for Multivariate Time Series through Stochastic Recurrent Neural Network
rows.model: OmniAnomaly uses a stochastic recurrent latent-variable model
rows.caveat: High complexity and benchmark protocol differences

rows.paper: USAD: UnSupervised Anomaly Detection on Multivariate Time Series
rows.model: Adversarially trained autoencoder ensemble
rows.caveat: Not condition-aware and can be evaluation-protocol sensitive

rows.paper: Multivariate Time-series Anomaly Detection via Graph Attention Network
rows.model: MTAD-GAT models temporal and feature dependencies
rows.caveat: More complex than LSTM-AE and not guaranteed better

rows.paper: TranAD: Deep Transformer Networks for Anomaly Detection in Multivariate Time Series Data
rows.model: Transformer-based reconstruction with adversarial training
rows.caveat: Reported scores may depend on evaluation conventions

rows.paper: Anomaly Transformer: Time Series Anomaly Detection with Association Discrepancy
rows.model: Uses association discrepancy for anomaly scoring
rows.caveat: Complex and benchmark-dependent

rows.paper: Memorizing Normality to Detect Anomaly: Memory-augmented Deep Autoencoder
rows.model: Restricts reconstruction to learned normal prototypes
rows.caveat: Not tailored to C-MAPSS sequences

rows.paper: An Evaluation of Anomaly Detection and Diagnosis in Multivariate Time Series
rows.model: Finds scoring functions can matter more than model architecture
rows.caveat: Not a C-MAPSS-specific comparison

rows.paper: Precision and Recall for Time Series
rows.model: Defines range-aware precision and recall
rows.caveat: Requires choices about range weighting

rows.paper: Towards a Rigorous Evaluation of Time-Series Anomaly Detection
rows.model: Shows point adjustment can make random scores look state of the art
rows.caveat: Focuses benchmark evaluation rather than PHM cost

rows.paper: Volume Under the Surface: A New Accuracy Evaluation Measure for Time-Series Anomaly Detection
rows.model: Provides range-aware ROC/PR surfaces across timing tolerances
rows.caveat: More complex to communicate than raw event metrics

rows.paper: Anomaly Detection in Time Series: A Comprehensive Evaluation
rows.model: Finds no detector family consistently dominates
rows.caveat: Not multivariate C-MAPSS-specific

rows.paper: Current Time Series Anomaly Detection Benchmarks are Flawed and are Creating the Illusion of Progress
rows.model: Documents benchmark flaws, mislabeled/trivial anomalies and unreliable rankings
rows.caveat: Not specifically an FD002 analysis

rows.paper: Navigating the Metric Maze: A Taxonomy of Evaluation Metrics for Anomaly Detection in Time Series
rows.model: Taxonomizes metric behavior and domain trade-offs
rows.caveat: Metric choice still requires operational semantics

rows.paper: A Unified Approach to Interpreting Model Predictions
rows.model: Introduces SHAP feature attributions
rows.caveat: Does not guarantee fidelity to a different black-box model through a surrogate

rows.paper: A Survey on Explainable Anomaly Detection
rows.model: Organizes explanation types and fidelity issues
rows.caveat: Survey; does not validate one project explanation

rows.paper: Anomaly Detection and Diagnosis in Manufacturing Systems
rows.model: Uses variable-wise residual/contribution ideas for diagnosis
rows.caveat: Different industrial assets

rows.paper: ReX: A Framework for Incorporating Temporal Information in Model-Agnostic Local Explanation Techniques
rows.model: Adapts local surrogate sampling and features to temporal inputs
rows.caveat: Not an anomaly-specific or C-MAPSS study

rows.paper: Outlier Ensembles: An Introduction
rows.model: Studies aggregation of heterogeneous outlier scores
rows.caveat: Ensembles can be degraded by correlated or weak detectors

rows.paper: Theoretical Foundations and Algorithms for Outlier Ensembles
rows.model: Formalizes outlier-score combination and normalization
rows.caveat: Theory is not a guarantee of benefit on FD002

rows.paper: A Multiple Classifier System for Prognostics of Aircraft Engines
rows.model: Demonstrates model/decision fusion in turbofan prognostics
rows.caveat: RUL/prognostics endpoint rather than unsupervised anomaly alerting

rows.paper: Adaptive Model Pooling for Online Deep Anomaly Detection from a Complex Evolving Data Stream
rows.model: ARCUS separates concept-driven inference from drift-aware model-pool updates
rows.caveat: Not C-MAPSS and substantially more complex

rows.paper: Autoencoder-based Anomaly Detection in Streaming Data with Incremental Learning and Concept Drift Adaptation
rows.model: Combines incremental AE learning with explicit drift detection
rows.caveat: Not a turbofan benchmark

rows.paper: The Impact of Neglecting Feature Scaling in K-means Clustering
rows.model: Demonstrates that feature scale changes Euclidean cluster assignments and quality
rows.caveat: Not C-MAPSS-specific

rows.paper: Aero-Engine Fault Detection with an LSTM Auto-Encoder and Self-Attention Mechanism
rows.model: Combines LSTM-AE and self-attention for fault detection
rows.caveat: Dataset/protocol not identical to FD002 project

rows.paper: Bifurcated Remaining Useful Life Prediction: A Hybrid Prognostic Framework
rows.model: Uses an LSTM autoencoder trained on nominal data with an RUL>150 state boundary
rows.caveat: RUL endpoint and 2026 publication; not direct detector benchmark

rows.paper: User's Guide for the Commercial Modular Aero-Propulsion System Simulation (C-MAPSS)
rows.model: Documents the simulator architecture, variables, interfaces, and intended use behind C-MAPSS-generated studies.
rows.caveat: A simulator guide, not an anomaly-detection benchmark or source of cycle-level degradation labels.

rows.paper: Aircraft Engine Run-to-Failure Dataset under Real Flight Conditions for Prognostics and Diagnostics
rows.model: Introduces N-CMAPSS with realistic flight profiles and component-level degradation for prognostics and diagnostics.
rows.caveat: N-CMAPSS is not interchangeable with the older FD002 benchmark and is substantially larger.

rows.paper: Anomaly Detection and Fault Disambiguation in Large Flight Data: A Multi-modal Deep Auto-encoder Approach
rows.dataset_subset: Aircraft electromechanical actuator; multiple operating conditions
rows.model: Trains a deep autoencoder on nominal multi-sensor windows; uses total and sensor-wise reconstruction error for detection and disambiguation.
rows.caveat: Not FD002 and faults are experimentally defined rather than gradual run-to-failure proxy labels.

rows.paper: Hybrid Deep Fault Detection and Isolation: Combining Deep Neural Networks and System Performance Models
rows.dataset_subset: C-MAPSS dynamic model; healthy plus four fault conditions
rows.model: Combines operating inputs and physics-model residual or calibrated virtual variables with AE/VAE/HELM/OCSVM diagnostics.
rows.caveat: Uses a separately generated fault-diagnostics dataset, not FD002 gradual-degradation proxies.

rows.paper: Operating Condition-Invariant Neural Network-based Prognostics Methods Applied on Turbofan Aircraft Engines
rows.model: Studies preprocessing and neural architectures with the goal of reducing operating-condition dependence.
rows.caveat: RUL prediction rather than anomaly alerting; timeliness and accuracy trade-offs use different endpoints.

rows.paper: Data-Driven Prognostics and Diagnostics of Industrial Machinery: A Turbofan Engine Case Study
rows.model: Examines efficient organization and transformation of large multivariate run-to-failure data for prognostics and diagnostics workflows.
rows.caveat: Focus is data organization and RUL workflow rather than a directly comparable anomaly detector.

rows.paper: Deep Autoencoding Gaussian Mixture Model for Unsupervised Anomaly Detection
rows.model: Jointly learns an autoencoder representation, reconstruction features, and a Gaussian-mixture energy model.
rows.caveat: Tabular benchmark method; temporal order and operating regimes require additional design.

rows.paper: Deep One-Class Classification
rows.model: Introduces Deep SVDD, optimizing a neural representation for a compact nominal-data hypersphere.
rows.caveat: Original experiments are image-centric; architecture constraints and collapse prevention matter.

rows.paper: MAD-GAN: Multivariate Anomaly Detection for Time Series Data with Generative Adversarial Networks
rows.model: Uses LSTM GAN components and a combined discrimination/reconstruction score for multivariate sequences.
rows.caveat: GAN instability and cyberattack intervals differ from gradual turbofan degradation.

rows.paper: A Deep Neural Network for Unsupervised Anomaly Detection and Diagnosis in Multivariate Time Series Data
rows.model: MSCRED models multi-scale inter-sensor signature matrices with a convolutional recurrent encoder-decoder.
rows.caveat: Computationally heavier and evaluates benchmarks with different anomaly intervals.

rows.paper: Graph Neural Network-Based Anomaly Detection in Multivariate Time Series
rows.model: GDN learns inter-sensor graph structure and predicts expected behavior, enabling anomaly scoring and variable-level interpretation.
rows.caveat: Learned graphs are not automatically causal and benchmark protocols differ.

rows.paper: Timeseries Anomaly Detection using Temporal Hierarchical One-Class Network
rows.model: THOC combines multi-scale dilated recurrent features with hierarchical one-class objectives.
rows.caveat: High model complexity and no condition-aware FD002 validation.

rows.paper: Multivariate Time Series Anomaly Detection and Interpretation Using Hierarchical Inter-Metric and Temporal Embedding
rows.model: InterFusion jointly models inter-metric and temporal dependencies with hierarchical stochastic latent variables.
rows.caveat: Model and interpretation complexity can obscure causal attribution and raise compute cost.

rows.paper: Time Series Anomaly Detection Using Generative Adversarial Networks
rows.model: TadGAN uses LSTM generators/critics, cycle consistency, reconstruction, and discriminator signals.
rows.caveat: Primarily univariate and computationally more fragile than classical or AE controls.

rows.paper: Unsupervised Anomaly Detection via Variational Auto-Encoder for Seasonal KPIs in Web Applications
rows.model: Donut modifies VAE training and reconstruction for missing, seasonal, unlabeled KPI data.
rows.caveat: Univariate seasonal KPI assumptions do not match multivariate run-to-failure engines.

rows.paper: Deep Semi-Supervised Anomaly Detection
rows.model: Deep SAD extends one-class representation learning to exploit small sets of labeled anomalies.
rows.caveat: FD002 has no trustworthy cycle-level anomaly labels for supervised fitting.

rows.paper: LUNAR: Unifying Local Outlier Detection Methods via Graph Neural Networks
rows.model: Frames KNN, LOF, and DBSCAN as message passing and learns a robust local-neighborhood anomaly ranker.
rows.caveat: Feature-based rather than sequential and requires trainable supervision signals constructed from neighborhoods.

rows.paper: Detecting Multivariate Time Series Anomalies with Zero Known Label
rows.model: MTGFlow uses a dynamic graph and entity-aware normalizing flow without assuming a perfectly clean nominal training set.
rows.caveat: Complexity is high and benchmark labels are unlike gradual FD002 onset proxies.

rows.paper: Time Series Anomaly Detection with Multiresolution Ensemble Decoding
rows.model: RAMED uses recurrent autoencoders with multiple decoder resolutions and coarse-to-fine fusion to reduce error accumulation.
rows.caveat: More complex than the registered LSTM-AE and not condition-aware.

rows.paper: DCdetector: Dual Attention Contrastive Representation Learning for Time Series Anomaly Detection
rows.model: Uses multi-scale dual attention and pure contrastive learning rather than reconstruction.
rows.caveat: Reported rankings can depend on evaluation conventions; model is not needed to answer the current causal preprocessing question.

rows.paper: TimeSeriesBench: An Industrial-Grade Benchmark for Time Series Anomaly Detection Models
rows.model: Evaluates unified-model, unseen-series, and practical metric settings across more than 168 configurations.
rows.caveat: Software-system time series and preprint status; not a direct FD002 comparison.

rows.paper: TSB-UAD: An End-to-End Benchmark Suite for Univariate Time-Series Anomaly Detection
rows.model: Standardizes many datasets and methods in a reproducible end-to-end benchmark.
rows.caveat: Univariate benchmark; FD002 is multivariate and engine-grouped.

rows.paper: TimeEval: A Benchmarking Toolkit for Time Series Anomaly Detection Algorithms
rows.model: Provides an extensible automated framework for comparable detector, dataset, runtime, and metric experiments.
rows.caveat: A toolkit does not solve FD002 label ambiguity or define engine-level operational metrics.

rows.paper: Evaluating Real-time Anomaly Detection Algorithms: The Numenta Anomaly Benchmark
rows.model: Defines time-sensitive anomaly windows and rewards early detection while penalizing false positives.
rows.caveat: Univariate streaming benchmark and application-weighted score are not directly transferable.

rows.paper: Local Evaluation of Time Series Anomaly Detection Algorithms
rows.model: Introduces affiliation precision/recall using distances between predicted and true event sets with local interpretation.
rows.caveat: Still requires meaningful labeled event ranges, which FD002 does not provide directly.

rows.paper: PATE: Proximity-Aware Time Series Anomaly Evaluation
rows.model: Weights early and delayed detections using buffer zones and provides proximity-aware area under precision-recall.
rows.caveat: Parameters and interval semantics must be fixed before seeing test results.

rows.paper: Do You Know Existing Accuracy Metrics Overrate Time-Series Anomaly Detections?
rows.model: Shows common range and point-adjusted metrics can overrate imprecise detections; proposes enhanced temporal precision/recall.
rows.caveat: No metric removes the need to define the operational meaning of an event.

rows.paper: Position: Quo Vadis, Unsupervised Time Series Anomaly Detection?
rows.model: Critiques flawed metrics, inconsistent benchmark practices, and weak justification for deep architectural complexity.
rows.caveat: Position paper rather than a detector benchmark; conclusions should guide protocol, not replace evidence.

rows.paper: Optimal Detection of Changepoints With a Linear Computational Cost
rows.model: Introduces PELT, an exact penalized segmentation algorithm with linear expected cost under stated conditions.
rows.caveat: Offline segmentation gives an estimated statistical change, not physical degradation ground truth.

rows.paper: Bayesian Online Changepoint Detection
rows.model: Maintains a posterior over run length to infer the most recent generative-parameter change online.
rows.caveat: Requires a predictive model and hazard prior; estimated change remains model-dependent.

rows.paper: Selective Review of Offline Change Point Detection Methods
rows.model: Organizes methods by cost function, search, and constraint; links theory to the ruptures implementation.
rows.caveat: A broad review; method selection and calibration remain application-specific.

rows.paper: Change-Point Detection in Time-Series Data by Relative Density-Ratio Estimation
rows.model: Estimates relative Pearson divergence directly between neighboring windows without separately estimating densities.
rows.caveat: Window and regularization choices affect onset; not a true FD002 label.

rows.paper: Kernel Change-Point Detection
rows.model: Uses kernel representations and model selection to find distributional changes beyond mean shifts.
rows.caveat: Computational and kernel-selection sensitivity; estimated changes are not physical labels.

rows.paper: Control Chart Tests Based on Geometric Moving Averages
rows.model: Foundational exponentially/geometrically weighted moving-average monitoring for small process shifts.
rows.caveat: Classical assumptions do not automatically hold for autocorrelated learned anomaly scores.

rows.paper: Continuous Inspection Schemes
rows.model: Introduces cumulative-sum inspection logic for persistent sequential shifts.
rows.caveat: CUSUM requires a declared in-control distribution and tuning for score dependence.

rows.paper: Learning from Time-Changing Data with Adaptive Windowing
rows.model: ADWIN adapts the window length from statistically detected changes rather than a fixed update horizon.
rows.caveat: Blind adaptation can still learn degradation; detector updates need a healthy-state gate.

rows.paper: A Survey on Concept Drift Adaptation
rows.model: Taxonomizes drift detection, adaptation strategies, evaluation, and application settings.
rows.caveat: Concept drift is not identical to irreversible degradation and supervised framing often differs.

rows.paper: Why Should I Trust You?: Explaining the Predictions of Any Classifier
rows.model: Introduces LIME, fitting an interpretable local surrogate around an individual prediction.
rows.caveat: Local surrogate fidelity and perturbation design are crucial, especially for correlated sequences.

rows.paper: Axiomatic Attribution for Deep Networks
rows.model: Introduces Integrated Gradients using sensitivity and implementation-invariance axioms.
rows.caveat: Attributions depend on the baseline and explain a scalar model output, not necessarily a causal fault.

rows.paper: Learning Important Features Through Propagating Activation Differences
rows.model: DeepLIFT decomposes output differences from a reference activation into feature contributions.
rows.caveat: Reference choice and network operation rules affect interpretation.

rows.paper: TimeSHAP: Explaining Recurrent Models through Sequence Perturbations
rows.model: Extends KernelSHAP to feature-, event-, and cell-level attributions with sequence pruning.
rows.caveat: Computational cost, perturbation realism, and correlated sensor-time inputs can weaken fidelity.

rows.paper: Explaining Anomalies Detected by Autoencoders Using SHAP
rows.model: Uses KernelSHAP around an autoencoder anomaly score to show features increasing or offsetting anomalousness.
rows.caveat: Perturbations and surrogate fidelity must be validated; explanations are not root-cause proof.

rows.paper: Feature Bagging for Outlier Detection
rows.model: Combines outlier detectors trained on random feature subsets to improve robustness in noisy high dimensions.
rows.caveat: Random sensor subsets may destroy important temporal/physical dependencies.

rows.paper: LSCP: Locally Selective Combination in Parallel Outlier Ensembles
rows.model: Selects locally competent base outlier detectors before combining their scores.
rows.caveat: Competence estimation without ground truth adds complexity and possible overfitting.

rows.paper: SUOD: Accelerating Large-Scale Unsupervised Heterogeneous Outlier Detection
rows.model: Accelerates many heterogeneous detectors using data reduction, model approximation, and balanced scheduling.
rows.caveat: An acceleration system does not establish that an ensemble improves scientific validity.

rows.paper: Interpreting and Unifying Outlier Scores
rows.model: Maps heterogeneous arbitrary outlier factors to a common interpretable range before comparison or combination.
rows.caveat: Probability-like normalization is model-based and not guaranteed to be calibrated probability.

rows.paper: Explainable Deep One-Class Classification
rows.model: FCDD makes a fully convolutional one-class output map serve directly as an anomaly explanation map.
rows.caveat: Image-specific architecture; not directly applicable to 30-by-21 sensor sequences.

rows.paper: On the Evaluation of Unsupervised Outlier Detection: Measures, Datasets, and an Empirical Study
rows.model: Studies evaluation measures, benchmark construction, contamination, and instability across many outlier detectors.
rows.caveat: Mostly tabular outlier settings; temporal grouping and early warning require additional metrics.
